basics.name: Priyanka Chatterjee
basics.label: Agentic AI & GenAI Engineer · Python · React/TypeScript · MCP · LLM Agents · 4+ Years

summaries.default: Full-stack Agentic AI and GenAI engineer with 4+ years building enterprise-grade LLM applications, multi-agent workflows, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, and real-time streaming copilot interfaces in Python and React/TypeScript. Built and shipped an MCP server providing standardized, real-time LLM agent access to enterprise cloud data; designed multi-agent workflows orchestrating LLM agents to generate, validate, and refine policy commands with self-correction loops. Architected RAG-based Pydantic AI agent ingesting documentation and code graphs into vector storage, deployed to AWS Lambda with Slack Bot API integration for instant developer onboarding. Strong expertise in full-stack AI: Python backends (FastAPI-style REST APIs, event-driven architectures), React/TypeScript frontends (WebSocket streaming, component SDKs), prompt engineering, tool/function calling, responsible AI guardrails, and production infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions).

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Built the Steampipe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server end to end in Python, providing LLM agents with standardized, real-time access to enterprise cloud and security data for retrieval and analysis; enables agentic workflows to interact with live infrastructure.

Designed a multi-agent workflow on the OpenAI Agents SDK orchestrating LLM agents that generate cloud preventive-policy commands (e.g., blocking public S3 buckets by region), validate them in a live test environment, self-correct failures, and score accounts against internal security metrics.

Built a RAG-based internal Pydantic AI agent that resolves cross-team queries by ingesting documentation and code graphs for all internal repositories into S3 vector storage; deployed to AWS Lambda and integrated with Slack Bot API, instantly resolving onboarding and cross-team queries for developers.

Designed and developed a REST API microservice in Go using the Gin framework with OAuth 2.0 authentication, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for internal microservices; handled production traffic for a SaaS platform.

Built a Kafka-based, fire-and-forget event-driven pipeline for policy-enforcement workflows with asynchronous consumer processing and dead-letter queue (DLQ) for fault tolerance; ensured reliability and observability in high-volume data processing.

Authored compliance and security modules in HCL + SQL covering 1,000+ resource checks across CIS (AWS, Azure, GCP), NIST, HIPAA, PCI DSS frameworks used by enterprise customers in finance and healthcare; implemented responsible AI practices and security guardrails for cloud governance.

Led an LLM-driven Claude Code skill automating code refactoring, unit test generation, deployment, and Terraform-driven integration testing; migrated 35+ Azure cloud-governance modules from polling to push-based eventing via Azure Event Grid, cutting latency 70–90%.

Engineered core features for Tailpipe (Go-based observability CLI on DuckDB + Parquet) lifting log-processing throughput 30% to 1,000+ records per second; authored 11 AWS log-source tables with standardized error handling and cross-platform smoke-test pipeline in GitHub Actions.

projects.name: Lila Tic-Tac-Toe — Real-Time Multiplayer Game
projects.description: Full-stack real-time system: React 19 + TypeScript frontend on Vercel; Go-based Nakama game server with PostgreSQL on Fly.io. Server-authoritative architecture over WebSocket transport with real-time state streaming, KV-storage matchmaking, optimistic UI with failure recovery, and reconnect-into-active-match reliability. Demonstrates streaming interfaces, real-time data synchronization, and distributed systems reliability patterns critical for copilot and agent UIs.

projects.name: General-Purpose AI Chatbot / Agent with MCP
projects.description: Agentic chatbot framework built with Pydantic AI featuring configurable external MCP servers via persistent MongoDB-backed registry, JSON config loader with strict validation, per-server failure isolation, native tool calling, mid-conversation multi-model switching (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, Mistral), conversation-history persistence, sync + streaming output, prompt-injection safeguards, and Logfire observability. Demonstrates multi-agent orchestration, tool integration, and production-grade LLM application architecture.
